name: kubernetes-ip-calculator
description: Kubernetes IP address calculator for Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS and on-premises clusters (kubeadm, Mirantis MKE, RKE2, OpenShift, Tanzu, Talos): max pods per node, VPC addresses per node, subnet per zone, pod and service ranges.
author: Rahul Wagh (https://jhooq.com)
